findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.citation_text:
3-101.11 Safe, Unadulterated, and Honestly Presented. FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, as specified under § 3-601.12, honestly presented.

A single set of frozen pizzas are observed in the display freezer with expiration dates of 2/26/25. The PIC discarded the items to correct. The PIC did state that they have been having issues with their supplier lately sending items that are past their expiration dates. Per the PIC these items are normally caught prior to being placed on the shelves but they have been off the past couple of days.
